name: DSLO v0.8 — Federated Geometry Constellation
description: Manifest describing all surfaces included in the DSLO v0.8 repository. This manifest documents human-authored geometry surfaces, federated geometry layers, invariant surfaces, mapping surfaces, registry anchors, formatting surfaces, metadata, and supporting materials. Folder structure is preserved exactly as present in the GitHub repository.

geometry_surfaces.description: The twelve DSLO v0.8 geometry surfaces, each a lawful, invariant-preserving, geometry-only extension of the v0.7 substrate.

layers.description: Federated geometry layers defining domain-class geometry, invariant families, mapping geometry, formatting surfaces, and registry anchors.

scientific_overview.description: DSLO v0.8 Scientific Overview, providing federated geometry context, lineage, continuity rules, and invariant-preserving vocabulary.

metadata.description: Metadata surfaces for scientific indexing, citation, and cross-surface alignment.

continuity.description: Continuity surfaces defining lawful v0.8 inheritance from v0.7.

collection.description: Collection-level metadata for DOI issuance, dataset aggregation, and scientific indexing.
